episodes.title: The Preacher That Starved His Followers To Death
episodes.description:
He called himself a pastor.

He told his followers the world
was ending.

He told them hospitals were satanic.
He told them schools were satanic.
He told them the only way to meet
Jesus was to stop eating.

To fast until death.

He said children should go first.

190 children died in a forest
in eastern Kenya.
Starved to death by their own parents
who believed every word he said.

Then police arrested him.

And while his followers in custody
continued refusing food because
their pastor had told them to fast,
a police informant reported something
that changed everything.

Paul Mackenzie was eating.

In secret. In his cell.
Making sure none of his followers
could see him.

The man who told 191 people to
starve for God never stopped
eating himself.

Not once.

On October 19th 2026, a Kenyan
high court convicted Paul Mackenzie
and 28 others of 191 counts of murder.

This story is happening right now.
The sentencing has not yet taken place.

Watch until the very end.
The detail about how he planned
the starvation in phases will
leave you completely silent.
